sourceClass: PRTS community wiki, not official documentation

pages.supports: EP is separate per element; loss uses EP resistance; depletion causes immediate burst effects; some attacks attach EP after HP damage.
pages.doesNotClose: Exact source/target generic Modifier events and EP-specific notification branches.

pages.supports: BeforeApplying/Applying/Applied are general Modifier points; Applying may be used for effects cancelling HP damage and EP loss together.
pages.limits: Page is marked incomplete; event ordering is reference only; its lethal row incorrectly labels the HP-protection concept as EP_ZERO and is not used for event identification.

pages.supports: Context for already archived case27's independently applied post-HP EP.
pages.limits: S1 front sampling difference is not used as evidence about EP versus external post-HP observers.

pages.supports: Concrete content responds before damage or EP loss from an available allied source at another tile, gaining SP and potentially invulnerability/teleport. Current resource binding is checked separately in content-helper.
